title: Menlo Ventures joins Anthropic's Series E

sources.quote: The round was led by Lightspeed Venture Partners, with participation from Bessemer Venture Partners, Cisco Investments, D1 Capital Partners, Fidelity Management & Research Company, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Menlo Ventures and Salesforce Ventures, among other new and existing investors.

explain: Menlo Ventures put money into Anthropic's $3.5 billion Series E (counted in full on the Lightspeed record). Menlo's own amount was not disclosed.
